office_does: The auditor runs county elections, assembles the county budget, handles accounts payable and payroll, records documents and oversees vehicle licensing.
race_blurb: Open seat: Auditor Heidi Hunt is retiring. Two deputies from her office are running, both preferring the Republican Party: Elections Administrator Jacque Laird, with 19 years in the office, and payroll deputy and Ritzville School Board member Courtney Fannin. Laird led the three-way primary with 1,060 votes to Fannin's 646.

candidates.summary: Adams County Elections Administrator, with 19 years in the Auditor's office across recording, accounts payable, payroll and elections; a first-time candidate.
highlights: Elections Administrator for 11 years; certified elections administrator [S1][S2]
Says her work across the office prepares her for 'a smooth and effective transition' [S1]

experience.basis: Not an incumbent, but a 19-year insider who runs on continuity and a smooth transition in the office she would lead.

candidates.summary: Payroll deputy in the Auditor's office for about five years after eight years of medical-practice management, and an elected Ritzville School Board member.
highlights: Says she implemented electronic recording and helped launch the county's new finance software [S1]
Would use technology to 'streamline operations, reduce costs' and be 'a careful steward of taxpayer dollars' [S1][S3]
Stresses election chain of custody, voter-roll accuracy and expanded voter outreach [S1][S2]

experience.basis: Mixed: an insider in the office and an elected school-board member, but with a shorter tenure there and a career largely outside government.

spending.basis: Explicit cost-reduction and stewardship framing for the office's budget and finance role.
